detail.requirements:
• Sound knowledge of general medicine or pharmacy and clinical practice
• Good verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to negotiate and communicate with internal and external customers
• Fluency in written and spoken English in addition to local language(s)
• a Bachelor or higher degree in pharmacy, or equivalent training as a healthcare provider
• Previous experience on the pharmaceutical industry and at least 1 projects experience in pharmaco economic research(PE) is desired
detail.main_tasks:
• Lead new drug /new indication P&R project
• Manage post-launch price events (PVA, price changes due to generics etc.)
• Develop P&R strategy and assess the feasibility of new pipelines
• Analyze global PE model and develop local PE data
• Lead environment shaping and stakeholder engagement
• Align business strategy as a business partner with cross-functional team
• Reimbursement criteria guidance, rejection management
detail.intro: Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow. Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.
detail.preferred_points:
• 5+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including 3+ years in Market Access (MA).
• Experience in health economics and outcomes research (HEOR) or health economic evaluation projects.
